title: Explicit override order
prompt:
Policy: VIP customers usually receive refunds. However, fraud flags override VIP status and forbid refunds. Used digital goods cannot be refunded unless an administrator approves. Customer is VIP, fraud-flagged, digital item used, administrator approves. Return eligible bool. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: eligible. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
